methods.label: Work backward through the practices
methods.explanation:
Moving backward one practice means dividing the number of free throws by \(2\). There are four steps from the fifth practice back to the first, so the counts are
\[
48\longrightarrow24\longrightarrow12\longrightarrow6\longrightarrow3.
\]
Jenny made \(\boxed{3}\) free throws at the first practice, choice \(\text{A}\).
methods.levelReason: Four elementary divisions by 2 completely solve the problem.
